mapper.sql:
select 'LEGACY' engine_mode, 'INV_TRANSFER' business_code, instance.instance_id legacy_instance_id, cast(instance.transfer_id as char) business_id, transfer_order.order_no business_no, (select count(1) from inv_transfer_approval_instance round_instance where round_instance.transfer_id = instance.transfer_id and round_instance.instance_id <= instance.instance_id) business_round, upper(instance.status) status, instance.current_node_order current_node_order, (select min(current_task.node_name) from inv_transfer_approval_task current_task where current_task.instance_id = instance.instance_id and current_task.node_order = instance.current_node_order and current_task.status = 'pending') current_node_name, applicant.user_id applicant_user_id, transfer_order.create_by applicant_name, case when transfer_order.transfer_type = 'store_return' then transfer_order.from_dept_id else transfer_order.to_dept_id end anchor_dept_id, case when transfer_order.transfer_type = 'store_return' then transfer_order.from_dept_name else transfer_order.to_dept_name end anchor_dept_name, instance.create_time started_time, case when instance.status = 'running' then null else instance.update_time end finished_time from inv_transfer_approval_instance instance join inv_transfer_order transfer_order on transfer_order.transfer_id = instance.transfer_id left join sys_user applicant on applicant.user_name = transfer_order.create_by
union all
select 'LEGACY' engine_mode, 'INV_STOCK_CHECK' business_code, instance.instance_id legacy_instance_id, cast(instance.check_id as char) business_id, instance.check_no business_no, instance.round_no business_round, upper(instance.status) status, 1 current_node_order, case when instance.status = 'running' then '运营总监' else null end current_node_name, instance.submitted_user_id applicant_user_id, instance.submitted_by applicant_name, instance.shop_dept_id anchor_dept_id, anchor_dept.dept_name anchor_dept_name, coalesce(instance.submitted_time, instance.create_time) started_time, instance.finished_time finished_time from inv_stock_check_approval_instance instance left join sys_dept anchor_dept on anchor_dept.dept_id = instance.shop_dept_id
mapper.select:
select legacy.engine_mode engineMode, legacy.business_code businessCode, legacy.legacy_instance_id legacyInstanceId, legacy.business_id businessId, legacy.business_no businessNo, legacy.business_round businessRound, legacy.status status, legacy.current_node_order currentNodeOrder, legacy.current_node_name currentNodeName, legacy.applicant_user_id applicantUserId, legacy.applicant_name applicantName, legacy.anchor_dept_id anchorDeptId, legacy.anchor_dept_name anchorDeptName, legacy.started_time startedTime, legacy.finished_time finishedTime from () legacy
order by legacy.started_time desc, legacy.legacy_instance_id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}

select legacy.engine_mode engineMode, legacy.business_code businessCode, legacy.legacy_instance_id legacyInstanceId, legacy.business_id businessId, legacy.business_no businessNo, legacy.business_round businessRound, legacy.status status, legacy.current_node_order currentNodeOrder, legacy.current_node_name currentNodeName, legacy.applicant_user_id applicantUserId, legacy.applicant_name applicantName, legacy.anchor_dept_id anchorDeptId, legacy.anchor_dept_name anchorDeptName, legacy.started_time startedTime, legacy.finished_time finishedTime from () legacy where legacy.business_code = #{businessCode} and legacy.legacy_instance_id = #{legacyInstanceId} limit 1

choose.when: select task.task_id taskId, task.node_order nodeOrder, task.node_name nodeName, task.candidate_user_names candidateNames, upper(task.status) status, case when task.status = 'approved' then 'APPROVE' when task.status = 'rejected' then 'REJECT' else null end action, task.approver_id operatorUserId, task.approver_name operatorName, task.comment comment, task.approve_time actionTime from inv_transfer_approval_task task where task.instance_id = #{legacyInstanceId} order by task.node_order, task.task_id

select task.task_id taskId, 1 nodeOrder, '运营总监' nodeName, task.candidate_user_names candidateNames, upper(task.status) status, upper(task.action) action, task.approver_user_id operatorUserId, task.approver_name operatorName, task.approval_comment comment, task.approval_time actionTime from inv_stock_check_approval_task task where task.instance_id = #{legacyInstanceId} order by task.task_id
choose.otherwise: select cast(null as signed) taskId, cast(null as signed) nodeOrder, cast(null as char) nodeName, cast(null as char) candidateNames, cast(null as char) status, cast(null as char) action, cast(null as signed) operatorUserId, cast(null as char) operatorName, cast(null as char) comment, cast(null as datetime) actionTime from dual where 1 = 0
